title: A Google Calendar event claims a milestone number that doesn't exist
author: nisaba
description: The hundred-fourth real recipe, the thirteenth leg of the claims-dangling-milestone family (after commit, issue-body, issue-comment, linear-comment, mention, milestone, readme, release, review-comment, slack-message, tweet, and email), and the third leg the google_calendar+github toolkit's own claims-X grid has grown (after calendar-event-claims-unfixed-issue and calendar-event-claims-unmerged-pr). Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (the shared seam_engine.milestone_claims grammar every sibling already imports) from a calendar event's own title+description and checks whether the named milestone exists at all -- not whether a real milestone's claim is TRUE (a future calendar-event-claims-open-milestone's own remit), but whether the number the claim names resolves to anything real. Genuinely distinct from a future calendar-side dangling-reference recipe: milestones and issues/PRs are separate GitHub number spaces, so a #N that is a real issue could still be a dangling milestone claim, and this recipe never opens ListIssues or ListPullRequests at all, only ListMilestones. Fixture-only, MOCK ONLY, never a live network call -- zero Google Calendar tools are exposed on the-hand gateway today, same WIP note both existing Calendar recipes already carry. Neither scope is new (ListMilestones sat on the oath table from founding; ListEvents has sat on the Google Calendar row since milestone-deadline-no-calendar-event) and google_calendar+github is not a new toolkit pair.
confidence_notes: Flat 0.8, not age-gated -- mirrors every other *-claims-dangling-milestone sibling's own reasoning (including email-claims-dangling-milestone's) rather than calendar-event-claims-unfixed-issue's/calendar-event-claims-unmerged-pr's 24-hour age-gated 0.85/0.5 bar: an OPEN milestone could close at any moment, so a fresh claim about it might just be a race the event hasn't caught up to yet, but a milestone number that does not exist right now will not spontaneously start existing later, so there is no grace period that means anything here. A claimed milestone number that DOES resolve to a real milestone is excluded at confidence 0.0 regardless of whether that milestone is open or closed -- whether the claim is true is a future calendar-event-claims-open-milestone's own seam, not this one's. An event with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all (a bare #N aside) produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken. Fixture-only (source: "fixture") per SCOPES.md's own WIP note on the Google Calendar toolkit: zero Calendar-capable tools are exposed on the-hand gateway's live toolset today -- the detection logic is real, the live read waits on the Hand's gateway, and only the fixture loader swaps for a real call the day one appears.
